# Just a Wrapper

> Just a Wrapper is an open-source, self-hosted AI workspace for teams, built on Claude Managed Agents. It gives users chat with agents, a file library, memory, skills, connected apps through Composio, scheduled tasks, team workspaces and optional Stripe credits billing. It is a Next.js 16 and React 19 app with Postgres (Neon) through Drizzle and Better Auth, MIT licensed, and designed to be forked and rebranded as a vertical AI product.

Key facts:

- Anthropic's Claude Managed Agents runs the agent loop, containers, memory stores, skills, vaults and scheduled runs. The app adds accounts, workspaces, files, permissions, billing and the interface.
- Three model tiers: Fast (Claude Haiku), Balanced (Claude Sonnet) and Expert (Claude Opus), set in `src/features/agents/config.ts`.
- Optional providers (Composio, Stripe, Resend, Exa, Browserbase, Vercel Blob, Vercel AI Gateway, PostHog) turn on when their keys are set and are resolved once in `src/lib/capabilities.ts`.
- Local setup: `pnpm install`, `pnpm run setup`, `pnpm dev`. Quality gate: `pnpm verify`.
- Live demo: https://wrapper.arnas.st
- Source: https://github.com/cptApe/just-a-wrapper
- Not affiliated with Anthropic.
